## Problem and change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue if any.

## Scope and roadmap

Identify the relevant phase of the 3-Phase Engineering Roadmap, or state that the
change is documentation/maintenance. Explain how behavior changes fit the
100-day medical countermeasure reference baseline. Call out any proposed scope
change explicitly.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their outcomes, or explain why they do not apply.

- [ ] Behavior changes have appropriate regression coverage.
- [ ] Documentation reflects any setup or behavior changes.
- [ ] Examples and fixtures contain only synthetic, nonconfidential data.
- [ ] The non-goals, reference baseline, and roadmap in README.md and CLAUDE.md are respected and remain synchronized.
- [ ] Claims distinguish implemented behavior from planned safeguards, including independent proof verification.
